ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import filterParam from modules::epicFiles output application/java var userId = attributes.headers['x-sf-user-id'] default "" // The link points back at the host Salesforce called (CloudHub URL, or localhost when run locally). var host = attributes.headers.host default "" var basePath = (attributes.listenerPath default "/api/*") replace /\/\*$/ with "" --- { epicId: payload.epicId, "type": payload."type", sfRecordId: payload.sfRecordId, fileId: payload.fileId, mode: lower(payload.mode default ""), filterParam: filterParam(payload."type"), sfUserId: if (userId matches /^[a-zA-Z0-9]{15}([a-zA-Z0-9]{3})?$/) userId else "", downloadBaseUrl: if (host matches /^[A-Za-z0-9.\-]+(:[0-9]{1,5})?$/) ("https://" ++ host ++ basePath ++ "/download/") else "" }

when.expression: #[isBlank(vars.filesRequest.epicId) or isBlank(vars.filesRequest.fileId) or isBlank(vars.filesRequest.downloadBaseUrl) or vars.filesRequest.filterParam == null or not (['preview', 'download'] contains vars.filesRequest.mode)]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import belongsTo, isPreviewType, isTooLarge, fileName, downloadName from modules::epicFiles output application/java var r = vars.filesRequest var file = payload.file default {} var ext = lower((file.extension default "") replace /^\./ with "") --- { resultCode: if (not belongsTo(payload, r."type", r.epicId)) "REFUSED" else if (not (payload.active default true) or file.status != "OK") "NOT_AVAILABLE" else if (isBlank(file.url default "")) "NOT_AVAILABLE" else if (r.mode == "preview" and not isPreviewType(ext, p('files.previewTypes'))) "REFUSED" else if (r.mode == "preview" and isTooLarge((file.size default 0) as Number, p('files.previewMaxBytes') as Number)) "TOO_LARGE" else "OK", name: if (isBlank(fileName(file.name))) ("file." ++ ext) else downloadName(fileName(file.name), ext), extension: ext, sizeBytes: (file.size default 0) as Number, attachedOn: payload.attachedOn default "", folderId: if (payload.folder is Object) (payload.folder.id default "") else (payload.folder default "") }

%dw 2.0 import failureCode from modules::epicFiles output application/json --- { resultCode: failureCode(error) }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var r = vars.filesRequest var f = vars.linkDecision var verb = if (r.mode == "preview") "Previewed" else "Downloaded" var summary = verb ++ " Applied Epic file " ++ r.fileId ++ " (" ++ (f.extension default "") ++ ")" --- { "type": "Log__c", records: [{ ht_LogLevel__c: "Info", ht_Status__c: "Resolved", ht_Source__c: "Files component", ht_Operation__c: if (r.mode == "preview") "PREVIEWED" else "DOWNLOADED", ht_RelatedRecord__c: vars.filesRequest.sfRecordId, ht_Epic_Record_Id__c: vars.filesRequest.epicId, (ht_User__c: vars.filesRequest.sfUserId) if (!isBlank(vars.filesRequest.sfUserId)), ht_SourceName__c: "yp-integration", ht_SourceMethod__c: "files/link", ht_OccurredDateTime__c: now(), ht_Message__c: if (sizeOf(summary) > 255) summary[0 to 254] else summary, ht_Details__c: [ "Action: " ++ verb ++ " (link handed out)", "File id (Applied Epic attachment): " ++ r.fileId, "File type: " ++ (f.extension default ""), "File size: " ++ ((f.sizeBytes default 0) as String) ++ " bytes", "Attached in Applied Epic on: " ++ (f.attachedOn default ""), "Applied Epic folder id: " ++ (f.folderId default ""), "Applied Epic record: " ++ (r."type" default "") ++ " " ++ (r.epicId default ""), "Salesforce record: " ++ (r.sfRecordId default ""), "Salesforce user: " ++ (if (isBlank(r.sfUserId)) "not sent" else r.sfUserId), "Link valid for: " ++ p('files.linkTtlMinutes') ++ " minutes" ++ (if (r.mode == "download") ", single use" else ""), "Mule environment: " ++ (p('mule.env') default ""), "Correlation id: " ++ correlationId ] joinBy "\n" }] }

%dw 2.0 output application/java var l = vars.link default {} var preview = l.mode == "preview" var code = (vars.downloadError.namespace default "") ++ ":" ++ (vars.downloadError.identifier default "") var summary = "Could not open Applied Epic file " ++ (l.fileId default "") ++ " (" ++ (l.extension default "") ++ ") for " ++ (if (preview) "preview" else "download") --- { "type": "Log__c", records: [{ ht_LogLevel__c: "Error", ht_Status__c: "New", ht_Source__c: "Files component", ht_Operation__c: if (preview) "PREVIEWED" else "DOWNLOADED", ht_Error_Code__c: if (sizeOf(code) > 80) code[0 to 79] else code, (ht_RelatedRecord__c: l.sfRecordId) if (!isBlank(l.sfRecordId)), (ht_Epic_Record_Id__c: l.epicId) if (!isBlank(l.epicId)), (ht_User__c: l.sfUserId) if (!isBlank(l.sfUserId)), ht_SourceName__c: "yp-integration", ht_SourceMethod__c: "download", ht_OccurredDateTime__c: now(), ht_Message__c: if (sizeOf(summary) > 255) summary[0 to 254] else summary, ht_Details__c: [ "Action: " ++ (if (preview) "preview" else "download") ++ " link opened, file not delivered", "Error code: " ++ code, "File id (Applied Epic attachment): " ++ (l.fileId default ""), "File type: " ++ (l.extension default ""), "Applied Epic record: " ++ (l.epicId default ""), "Salesforce record: " ++ (l.sfRecordId default ""), "Salesforce user: " ++ (if (isBlank(l.sfUserId)) "not sent" else l.sfUserId), "Mule environment: " ++ (p('mule.env') default ""), "Correlation id: " ++ correlationId ] joinBy "\n" }] }
